_meta.note: Pins, not curves. Each row is a channel's composed value at the Theta=20 reference with zero contributions (uniform rule). Growth stays on ChannelLadder B_ch / the tier ladder; nothing here grows. Rate-channel rows carry PinValue only (cMilli 0, unused): the sigmoid divisor stays the universal 100.0. v2.json frozen. Deliberately absent: status.power/resist (status-anchor owns their base — scale determines unit), attackInterval/produceInterval (interval-ledger owns their ms reference), zombieSpeed (battle-tempo's channel — another program's pin to author), '' (channel-less families resolve via the status anchor path, never a curve).
_meta.rebalance: Never hand-edit this file. A balance pass republishes power-scale.v{n+1}.json; every prior version stays on disk for revert.

_sharedDialNote: curve+weights are identical to v2 by design: one ladder, one dial. A dial change republishes every version; v3 never forks the curve, it only adds channel pins.

arm1Max.reason: Outer-armor cap at reference depth: clears Flat armor stacks, ordered above the defense pin 22 (armor is the outer layer).

arm2Max.reason: Inner-armor cap: half the arm1Max order (two-layer structure).

combat.power.{variant}.reason: Aggregate offence magnitude at atk order (v2 atk pin 92); reviewer to confirm against the power/atk relationship.

combat.defense.{variant}.reason: Same order as the v2 defense pin 22: a per-element slot reads the same magnitude.

combat.shield.capacity.{variant}.reason: Pool sized against HP: 20% of the BaseHp pin 680 at reference depth.

combat.shield.toughness.{variant}.reason: Contest-point scale at dodge parity (BaseDodge(20)=520): toughness-vs-pen is a same-scale difference like accuracy-vs-dodge.

combat.shield.pen.{variant}.reason: Counterpart of toughness: same scale by symmetry.

combat.shield.regen.{variant}.reason: Per-second pool refill sized against the expander's share math, not just the pool: m1 = round(35 x pin/1000) must clear zero at tier 1, so pin 140 yields m1=5/s (~4% of the capacity pin per tier-1 point). A capacity-proportional 14 would price to m1=0 and trip the flat-tier lint — the share gate, not the pool, sets the floor.

combat.accuracy.{variant}.reason: Read, not authored: BaseAccuracy(20)=220+26*20 (BattleModels.cs). PinValue only; no growth implied.

combat.dodge.{variant}.reason: Read, not authored: BaseDodge(20)=26*20. PinValue only.

combat.crit.rate.{variant}.reason: Read, not authored: BaseCritRate(20)=10*20. PinValue only.

combat.crit.resist.{variant}.reason: Read, not authored: BaseCritResist(20)=10*20+250. PinValue only.

combat.crit.damage.{variant}.reason: Identity multiplier in per-mille (1.0x); the class is bounded (1.0x,2.0x) by its own math.

combat.crit.resist.damage.{variant}.reason: Identity multiplier in per-mille (1.0x); same bound.
